name: Sheet
intent: Panel that slides in from a screen edge for contextual work beside the page — editing, details, or secondary navigation.
when: Edit or inspect an item without losing page context
Secondary navigation or filters from the side
Content too large for a Popover but that shouldn't block the whole page

chooseOver.because: Dialog is a centered blocking modal; Sheet stays edge-anchored and feels less interruptive
Drawer is the touch/mobile bottom sheet; Sheet is the desktop side panel
Popover is for small anchored content; Sheet is a full-height edge panel

commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use Drawer for mobile bottom sheets

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Sheet when the task must block the whole page
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use Dialog when the task must block the whole page
